title: Initiation
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight initiates Ryan into the sales world through a series of tests and challenges, culminating in Ryan's first sales call. Meanwhile, Jan instructs Pam to keep a detailed log of Michael's daily activities, leading to late-night work and a phone conversation with Jim. Michael enforces office order during Pretzel Day and announces restructuring with increased accountability. The episode blends humor, conflict, and relationship dynamics as the office navigates these changes.

main_threads.thread: Dwight mentors Ryan through a series of initiation challenges and tests, including brain teasers, physical challenges, and a first sales call.
